title: mkdir
definition: Make Directory. The command used to create new directories (folders) in the file system.
simpleExplanation: The 'Create New Folder' button in the terminal.
realWorldExample: You start a new project. You type `mkdir src` and it creates a folder named 'src'.

intermediate: How do you create a folder AND a subfolder inside it at the exact same time (e.g., `mkdir parent/child`) without getting an error?

answers.question: Create parent and child?
answers.answer: Use the `-p` (parents) flag: `mkdir -p parent/child`. It automatically creates any missing parent directories required.

tableData.title: Crucial Command Flags
rows: Parents. Create parent directories as needed, no error if existing.
Verbose. Print a message for each created directory.
